methodology.survey_2026: Pew American Trends Panel, 5,166 U.S. adults, Aug 24–30 2026

rules: Do not treat regularly getting news on YouTube as watching only political commentary.
Keep U.S. adult population prevalence distinct from YouTube user prevalence and from composition of regular news consumers.
Political party distribution comes from voluntary aggregate survey responses, not inferred watch history.
Gender, race/ethnicity, age and party composition are 2025 survey observations and must not be treated as 2026 community census.
Do not use this information for individual persuasion targeting, sensitive profile enrichment or advertising to minors.
Shares can fail to sum to 100 because of rounding, nonresponse and categories not shown.
This study cannot estimate creator earnings, ad suitability or niche CPM.
